correctness.rationale: The source field polynomial is primitive, \(a_1=\alpha^{17}\) lies in \(\mathbb F_{16}\setminus\mathbb F_2\), and \(a_2=\alpha\) lies outside \(\mathbb F_{16}\). Exact trace evaluation gives \(119\) defining coordinates. The eight evaluation rows have rank \(8\), are pairwise orthogonal, and the complete \(256\)-word census reproduces \(1+136z^{56}+119z^{64}\). Unique RREF enumeration gives exactly \(255,10795,97155,200787,97155,10795,255,1\) message subspaces by dimension. For each basis, the union of basis-codeword supports is exactly the generated subcode support. The exhaustive \(417198\)-subspace census therefore proves every claimed support multiplicity and generalized-weight minimum.
